newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romania's President Emil Constantinescu told Polish parliament that Romania and Poland cannot afford to stay out at the gates of the European Union, and pleaded for joint integration of both countries in European structures.

* Visiting World Bank experts met heads of both chambers of parliament and Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea and discussed the centrist coalition government's reform programme. An expert Bank mission is expected in Romania within weeks.

* Romanian and Ukrainian negotiators ended a round of bilateral treaty talks on Tuesday. They decided to deepen the main issue of negotiations still unsolved and to have another round of talks in Ukraine as soon as posible.

* Bucharest's ad-interim mayor will be appointed on Thursday, after when Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea, now acting mayor, presents his resignation. Ciorbea will also present his report on his 200 days in office at the mayorship. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
